shared_identities.relationship: The primary and system/old duplicate ZIP within each release have matching SHA-256. The HX IMD is a separate representation.
Matching launcher SHA-256 across the three layouts. The raw and five-ZIP compare has 132 same-name byte matches and other differences.
The same version banner appears across separate 3000 and SX media; neither identical edition nor equal media is inferred.

In the program archive and SX Disk 3, 15 same-name files match and 10 differ. All nine TW*.EXE application and auxiliary executables match. DESK.EXE, DMPLUS.COM, ALARM.ARM, and seven help files differ.
34 common names and 31 exact member matches, including DESK.EXE and MAINMENU.PDM. DMCSR.MOD, ART.PNT, and XMAS.SNG differ; MENUDATA.TAN is HX-only, DMNOTEPD standalone-only.

Pooled by exact uppercase filename, nine/raw have 145 byte matches of 146 common names; five/raw have 113 of 136; nine/five have 112 of 134. A byte match requires one equal instance across repetitions.
